startDateTime.description: Start instant, ISO 8601 with offset (per config.timezone).

endDateTime.description: End instant, ISO 8601 with offset (per config.timezone).

startEpochMs.description: Start instant as epoch milliseconds (absolute UTC).

endEpochMs.description: End instant as epoch milliseconds (absolute UTC).

durationDays.description: Whole calendar days between start and end (0 = same day).

durationLabel.description: Pre-formatted span for display, e.g. '3 days' or '6h 30m'.

isValid.description: True when both endpoints are set, end is after start, and the span is within spanDays.
